senses.gloss: च्यवनः N. of a Ṛṣi (son of Bhṛgu, author of Rv. 10. 19.).

—1 Moving, motion.
—2 Being deprived of, loss; deprivation.
—3 Dying, perishing.
—4 Sinking, falling.
—5 Departure, deviation.
—6 Flowing, trickling.

च्यवान a. Moving, active; च्यवाना सुमतिं भुरण्यू Rv. 6. 62. 7.
━m. N. of a Ṛṣi restored to youth by the Aśvins; युवं
 च्यवानमश्विना जरन्तं पुनर्युवानं चक्रथुः शचीभिः Rv. 1. 117. 13.
च्यावन a. Causing to fall; अच्युतच्यावनोऽरीणां संस्कृतो विकृतिर्वृषः Mb. 12. 43. 9.
